omissions.detail: the archive keeps the session's last size and not the sizes it had before, so the file names that one
whether the archive lost output beyond the ranges listed under gaps is not reported by the host, so the file does not say
ranges of output the archive no longer holds, each listed under gaps with its cause
bytes at the start of output that began after a range the archive no longer holds, which are not read: they may be the end of a control string, such as a clipboard write, whose start is gone
requests to write the clipboard, which a replay would perform
questions the program asked the terminal, among them reads of the clipboard, which the terminal engine answers itself and a replay would be asked again

bytes of the retained output that are not carried. The kinds above are the ones that are counted; the rest, such as raw eight-bit controls, hyperlinks and titles the terminal engine refused, and the controls inside a sequence, are counted only here, with those that need the screen drawn again
